Medium Affected: WATER

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 30 gallons
CALLER REPORTED THAT A DRIVER OF A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK WAS NOT PAYING ATTENTION AND RAN OVER A CURB. THE ACCIDENT CAUSED DAMAGED TO A LINE ON THE TRAILER, RESULTING A RELEASE OF APPROX 30 GALLONS OF # 2 DIESEL FUEL ONTO THE GROUND, AND ULTIMATELY INTO A STORM DRAIN LEADING TO A RETENTION POND. THE DRIVER OF THE TRUCK GOT OUT AN TEMPORARILY PLUGGED THE LINE TO STOP THE RELEASE. THE TRAILER IS BEING EMPTIED, AND WILL BE TOWED OFF SITE. THERE WERE NO FIRE OR INJURIES REPORTED AT THIS TIME.
